acceptanceCriteria: A fixture modelled on the FinancesApp shape (hooks, expression props on non-Route elements, literal Route paths) admits every literal Route as a screen.
Non-literal children still record an unknown at their own line without discarding literal siblings.
body: Found in the V1-1677 spike (2026-10-18, docs/build-log/2026-10-18-cce-spike-v1-1677.md) on actualbudget/actual bde50c3be, packages/desktop-client/src/components/FinancesApp.tsx. The <Routes> tree at line 264 sits inside a function component that uses hooks, and neighbouring elements carry expression props such as resetKeys={[location.pathname]}. The map read 0 screens, with unknowns dynamic-route-context (line 1) and non-literal-react-children (line 264), so every changed span then read unplaced-path or reference-graph-bound. Distinct from V1-1169 (imported or computed route arrays): here the Route elements themselves have literal path props. Expected: each <Route path="literal"> under the tree is admitted as a screen, with an unknown recorded only for the non-literal children. Actual: the whole router abstains.
title: appmap react-router/0: JSX <Routes> trees inside components with expression props and hooks read 0 screens
